name: SSLMate Cert Spotter CT search API
tier_rationale: SSLMate, Inc. is an established company with published API documentation, terms and a business offering for its Certificate Transparency search API (A8 trusted); P001 chair file: ct_logs provider_tier trusted (crt.sh, Cert Spotter, ctl.shodan.io).

reliability.justification: Indexes public Certificate Transparency logs and merges precertificate and certificate entries per issuance; only unexpired issuances are listed, so it is a partial view of a domain's certificate history.

certspotter.description: SSLMate Cert Spotter API key (Authorization: Bearer; raises the hourly issuance-query allowance)
certspotter.plan_hint: keyed use is key-terms: record key_plans.certspotter = business (v3lum keys set certspotter --plan business) before it runs under the corporate profile (A1, P001 cond 3)

issuances.title: Cert Spotter /v1/issuances with the team's API key (Authorization: Bearer)

terms.quote: When you're ready to launch in production, we ask that you sign up for an account and authenticate to the API using one the following methods: Specify an API key in the Authorization header as a Bearer Token.

issuances.notes: Binding council text (P001 cond 2-3): 'Cert Spotter keyed = key-terms'; 'Cert Spotter runs with the team's own key once key_plans.certspotter is recorded (A1)'. Endpoint https://api.certspotter.com/v1/issuances?domain={apex}&include_subdomains=true&expand=dns_names&expand=issuer[&after={last id}] (research C0008, verified 2026-11-26): only unexpired issuances; pagination with after=<id of the last issuance> until an empty page (at most 5 pages per entity, P001 cond 5). The final empty page is a 200 carrying 'Retry-After: 3600' (a polling hint, never a rate limit). Errors are JSON {code, message} with 4xx/5xx (code rate_limited with HTTP 429). Upstream family ct-logs: never an independent vote next to crt.sh or ctl.shodan.io.

issuances_keyless.title: Cert Spotter /v1/issuances without a key (small hourly allowance, personal or evaluation use)

terms.quote: You can make a limited number of unauthenticated "List Issuances for a Domain" queries per hour, for personal or evaluation purposes.

issuances_keyless.notes: Binding council text (P001 cond 2-3): 'keyless = noncommercial (SSLMate: personal or evaluation)'; off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared. Live 2026-11-26 from a datacenter egress: X-Ratelimit-Limit 10 per hour without a key (HTTP 429 with Retry-After when exhausted).
issuances_keyless.licensed_alternative: The team's own Cert Spotter key with key_plans.certspotter = business (source sslmate.issuances); crt.sh (crtsh.search) alone keeps ct_logs useful.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G01-1 (P001 ct_logs). One key per provider (certspotter, Bearer header only, P001 cond 3). Quota block: the free account's 100 issuance queries per hour (research C0008, not published as a figure; keyless calls are capped at about 10 per hour per egress IP and answer 429 + Retry-After). ttl 4 h follows the API's Cache-Control max-age=14400.
